references.text: Caleb silenced the people and urged them to go up and take possession of the land, a similar encouragement to claim the land as their own.
The spies described the land as very good, just as the Danites described the land they had explored.
Moses encouraged the people not to fear or lose heart, but to go up and take possession of the land, a similar exhortation as here.
God gave the land to Israel and commanded them to enter and take it as their own, the same theme of conquering the promised land.
Joshua rebuked the tribes for hesitating to take possession of the land, the same warning against laziness and delay.
Description of the good land with cities and blessings that God gave them, the same theme of a good land to enter.
